title: Free Night Awards Interpretation Note: Relocations Compensated in the Last Two Years
content:
**Rule.** For one of the Free Night Awards coming back from a reservation the hotel relocated, the relocations reduction counts the relocation compensation postings on the membership within the twenty-four calendar months before the return, the posting for this relocation included: at least the upper relocations count earns the upper relocations reduction, exactly one the lower relocations reduction, and none nothing. The reduction is taken off the walked-night protected price once.

| Relocation compensation postings within the 24 calendar months before the return | Relocations reduction |
|---|---|
| 2 or more (upper relocations count) | 5000 points (upper relocations reduction) |
| Exactly 1 | 2000 points (lower relocations reduction) |
| None | No relocations reduction |

**What is counted.** The postings counted are the Ashbury Rewards points bonuses posted to the membership as relocation compensation, each counted once, by posting date within the twenty-four calendar months before the date of the return. The posting for this relocation is included.

**Example (hypothetical account).** The membership shows relocation compensation bonuses posted 30 months, 14 months and 1 week before the return, the last one for the present relocation. Two of them fall within the twenty-four months, so the relocations reduction is 5000 points; the posting from 30 months before is outside the window.
